description:
Query individual analytics rows. Use for qualitative data like response text, specific identifiers, or individual mentions.

Schedule selection: pass schedule: "default" or a custom/archived UUID from the schedule catalog, or an array of them to combine schedules. Omit to use the caller default (Ask Athena uses the current page selection). Explicit selection overrides that default. Existing top-level equality predicates on prompt_schedule_kind/id remain supported, but cannot conflict with schedule. Historical provenance does not change with current prompt membership. Website-level cubes are unaffected.

Cubes (same set as query_metrics): attributes, citations, competitors, contents, prompts, response_mentions, responses, source_mentions, sources, topics, websites.
Returns { rows, nextCursor, hasMore }. Pass nextCursor back as "after" to paginate.
prompt_status is the prompt's paused flag (boolean, true = paused), not a status string.
On the responses cube, content is hydrated from Postgres and can only be selected. Do not filter or sort by content. Use search_terms_in_responses for text frequency analysis.
Use query_metrics for aggregates instead.

Filter.description: Prisma-style filter. A bare scalar value on a dim is shorthand for `eq` (e.g. `{ is_website: true }`); bare arrays and op-less objects throw — use `{ in: [...] }` / `{ hasSome: [...] }` explicitly. Operators: eq, neq, in, notIn, gt, gte, lt, lte, isNull, like, ilike, startsWith, hasSome, hasEvery, hasNone. Combinators: AND, OR, NOT. On semi-join dims (e.g. `response_mentions_entity`, `prompt_tag_ids`), `hasSome`/`in` emit `IN (SELECT …)` and `hasNone`/`notIn` emit `NOT IN (SELECT …)`; combine both on one dim to express "includes any of A but none of B". Empty `AND: []` / `OR: []` throw (the math identities are asymmetric — drop the clause before passing). Empty list operators (`hasSome: []` / `hasNone: []` / `hasEvery: []`) also throw — drop the predicate or supply at least one value. NOT accepts a single Filter only — for arrays use `NOT: { AND: [...] }` (`not all`) or `NOT: { OR: [...] }` (`none`). NOT keeps rows whose value is NULL: `NOT { sentiment: { eq: "positive" } }` returns unanalyzed responses as well as negative and neutral ones, because "not positive" is true of a row with no sentiment. Exclude them explicitly with `AND: [{ NOT: {...} }, { sentiment: { isNull: false } }]`.

after.description: Last row from previous page for keyset pagination. Must include values for all orderBy dims.

orderBy.description: ORDER BY. If omitted, uses cube default order.

schedule.description: One schedule from the catalog ("default" or a custom/archived UUID), or an array of them to combine their data. Omit to use the caller default. The retired "manual" token is accepted as a deprecated alias of "default". Website-level cubes are unaffected.

website_id.description: The website to query. Must be a website your credentials can access.

name: query_rows
